While the study also explores an inflammatory milieu (IL1β), the PRIDE metadata and the 'Proteomic Analysis' section explicitly state the MS analysis was performed between Nanocomp - US and Nanocomp + US. The US stimulation is a physical/mechanical stimulus. No specific child class for ultrasound was available in the ontology, so it is mapped to the parent 'mechanical' category.
